description: Perform OCR on images to extract text with confidence scores. Supports screenshots, scanned documents, photos of text. Returns structured text with confidence metrics. Essential for agents processing visual content.

image_content.description: Base64 encoded image content (alternative to image_path)

image_path.description: Path to the image file (supports PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF)

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence score (0-100) to include text

extract_words.description: Extract individual words with bounding boxes

language.description: OCR language code (eng, spa, fra, deu, etc.)

preprocess.description: Apply image preprocessing for better OCR

preserve_whitespace.description: Maintain original spacing and line breaks

name: parse_image_text
